Sản phẩm có đầy đủ COA, MSDS và nguồn gốc xuất xứ rõ ràng.
[Phát triển & Hợp tác]

### Phát triển & Hợp tác

Xây dựng mối quan hệ lâu dài với khách hàng và đối tác trong nước và quốc tế.

## Đồng hành cùng doanh nghiệp bằng giải pháp hóa chất an toàn, ổn định và hiệu quả.

KDC CHEMICAL luôn đặt chất lượng sản phẩm và sự hài lòng của khách hàng làm trung tâm. Chúng tôi
cung cấp không chỉ hóa chất mà còn mang đến giải pháp kỹ thuật giúp tối ưu chi phí và nâng cao hiệu
quả sản xuất.

  briquettes for grilling to ore or residue briquettes for furnaces. Maxton's high-pressure roll
  briquetting sometimes means that no binder is needed for cohesion, allowing you to avoid the added
  cost of heating and curing as seen in other forms of agglomeration.
* [Maxton's Specializing
  [fresh granules are drying in our belt dryer]][64]
  
  ## [Drying][65]
  
  Drying is a critical aspect of materials processing, throughout the journey from raw material to
  end product, the ability to control moisture content helps to reduce shipping costs, streamline
  downstream processing, and produce a refined product. Materials dried under suitable temperature
  also helps to improve the quality and get a satisfying required product.
* [Maxton's Specializing
  [baked sponge iron pellet output from furnace through conveyor]][66]
  
  ## [Granulation][67]
  
  Granulation can be considered the same as pelletization, the method of agglomeration or particle
  size enlargement, but it often refers specifically to applications within the fertilizer and
  metallurgy industry. Maxton's granulation process follows a dry way or wet way which is carried
  out in quality, longevity granulators. The process could be different depends on the feedstock,
  the end product, and the way used.
* [Maxton's Specializing
  [horizontal high speed band saw is cutting a aluminum ingot]][68]
  
  ## [Hot Rolling][69]
  
  Maxton delivers high-quality, high-efficiency auxiliary equipment for hot rolling, including
  peeling machines, scalping machines, band saws, and circular saws. Our machines help reduce
  production investment in your hot rolling process while maximizing processing accuracy and
  material utilization. Its equipment adopts advanced automated control technology, enabling precise
  adjustment of processing parameters, reducing material waste, and improving production efficiency.
  Additionally, Maxton's equipment is designed with a focus on durability and stability, allowing it
  to operate for extended periods under high-load conditions, minimizing maintenance costs and
  downtime, and ensuring continuous production.
* [Maxton's Specializing
  [solid material is mixing with binder in paddle mixer]][70]
  
  ## [Mixing][71]
  
  Mixing and blending are one of the most widely used operating units, the industry areas could be
  in building materials, chemical industry, cosmetics, plastics, metallurgy, food, pharmaceuticals,
  polysaccharides and environment. The mixing procedure has a significant effect on the quality of
  the mixture produced and the economic efficiency of the production process. It is very important
  to correctly select mixing equipment under different process conditions to meet the requirements
  of safety, energy saving and high efficiency.
* [Maxton's Specializing
  [A big shaft from client's drawing is under prodcution]][72]
  
  ## [Production][73]
  
  A professional supplier of carbon steel, low alloy steel castings, iron castings, forgings,
  fabrications and other machinery components. Our production processes could be casting, forging,
  stamping, machining, fabrication and assembly. We provide technical support, production all-time
  supervision and quality track service. Special request products are also available.

## Mission

The mission of the NaCLO project is to promote the culture of hygiene and to participate in the
development, not only of health, of communities in low- and middle-income countries.

## **NaCLO Project**

**NaCLO is a key part of the ‘Hygiene and Disinfection’ project**, which aims to encourage and
support the dissemination of the culture of hygiene and the importance of disinfection in low and
middle-income countries.

It is an ambitious and wide-ranging project that contemplates health as an essential requirement for
the development of countries.

Medivac’s NaCLO project has hygiene as a priority: thus, in addition to initiatives aimed at
improving hygiene and health, NaCLO also embraces educational, micro-entrepreneurship and
international profit-non-profit cooperation initiatives.

[meet our team][26]

> ### How did the idea for NaCLO come about?

The project is the result of long journeys in rural Africa by our friend Franco Ladavas, a former
member of the Board of Directors of Industrie De Nora SpA, a world leader in the construction of
electrochemical plants. Thanks also to his experience as a chemist, Ladavas realized how to tackle
the serious lack of hygiene in low- and middle-income countries.

read below

A shortage made even more dramatic by largely inadequate health systems: a combination that
constitutes an enormous obstacle to the overall development of those countries. Ladavas thus became
aware that he could contribute to improving the sanitary situation in Africa and founded the
Association “Amici di Marco ETS”, in memory of his son Marco who died prematurely. Immediately
afterwards, he involved his friend Carlo Valesi and MEDIVAC Srl in the conception and construction
of a small electro-chlorinator suitable for producing electrolytic sodium hypochlorite on site in a
simple and low-cost way. Ladavas and Valesi have only one goal: to equip health centers and
hospitals with a system for the local and on-demand production of disinfectant.

So, in 2009, they installed one of the first devices to produce electrolytic sodium hypochlorite in
the hospital of Uvira (Democratic Republic of Congo), thanks to which they could also train local
technicians in the management of the equipment, in the production and use of the disinfectant in its
different dilutions. Subsequently, other devices were installed in several African countries and in
Bangladesh. During the years 2019-2021, MEDIVAC Srl then undertook to redesign and rationalize the
production system to facilitate its transport, installation, and production start-up, also equipping
it with photovoltaic panels (optional) to make it usable anywhere.

** Thus, the NaCLO 30 mini-plant and the NaCLO Solar kit were born.**

## **NaCLO Project**

**NaCLO is a key part of the ‘Hygiene and Disinfection’ project**, which aims to encourage and
support the dissemination of the culture of hygiene and the importance of disinfection in low and
middle-income countries.

It is an ambitious and wide-ranging project that contemplates health as an essential requirement for
the development of countries.

Medivac’s NaCLO project has hygiene as a priority: thus, in addition to initiatives aimed at
improving hygiene and health, NaCLO also embraces educational, micro-entrepreneurship and
international profit-non-profit cooperation initiatives.

[meet our team][26]

> ### How did the idea for NaCLO come about?

The project is the result of long journeys in rural Africa by our friend Franco Ladavas, a former
member of the Board of Directors of Industrie De Nora SpA, a world leader in the construction of
electrochemical plants. Thanks also to his experience as a chemist, Ladavas realized how to tackle
the serious lack of hygiene in low- and middle-income countries.

read below

A shortage made even more dramatic by largely inadequate health systems: a combination that
constitutes an enormous obstacle to the overall development of those countries. Ladavas thus became
aware that he could contribute to improving the sanitary situation in Africa and founded the
Association “Amici di Marco ETS”, in memory of his son Marco who died prematurely. Immediately
afterwards, he involved his friend Carlo Valesi and MEDIVAC Srl in the conception and construction
of a small electro-chlorinator suitable for producing electrolytic sodium hypochlorite on site in a
simple and low-cost way. Ladavas and Valesi have only one goal: to equip health centers and
hospitals with a system for the local and on-demand production of disinfectant.

So, in 2009, they installed one of the first devices to produce electrolytic sodium hypochlorite in
the hospital of Uvira (Democratic Republic of Congo), thanks to which they could also train local
technicians in the management of the equipment, in the production and use of the disinfectant in its
different dilutions. Subsequently, other devices were installed in several African countries and in
Bangladesh. During the years 2019-2021, MEDIVAC Srl then undertook to redesign and rationalize the
production system to facilitate its transport, installation, and production start-up, also equipping
it with photovoltaic panels (optional) to make it usable anywhere.

## Steels

***Welcome to our Steel Metals***

Steel is a strong and shiny metal that helps make many things we use every day, like cars,
buildings, and tools. It is made from iron and a little bit of carbon, which makes it tough and
perfect for building. Steel is important because it keeps our homes and schools safe. We can recycle

Энергия. Технологии. Надежность.

Систэм Электрик (Systeme Electric) – российская производственная компания с мировой экспертизой. Мы
предлагаем комплексные решения в области электроэнергии и промышленной автоматизации и делаем
процессы безопасными, эффективными и технологичными.

В 2022 году Schneider Electric (Шнайдер Электрик) приняла решение продать российские активы местному
менеджменту. Так появилась компания Systeme Electric.

Энергия. Технологии. Надежность.

Систэм Электрик (Systeme Electric) – российская производственная компания с мировой экспертизой. Мы
предлагаем комплексные решения в области электроэнергии и промышленной автоматизации и делаем
процессы безопасными, эффективными и технологичными.

В 2022 году Schneider Electric (Шнайдер Электрик) приняла решение продать российские активы местному
менеджменту. Так появилась компания Systeme Electric.

A unit is a measurement of a quantity that is defined or adopted by tradition or law. Other
quantities can be expressed as a multiple of the unit.

In human history, various unit systems were developed and used in different regions and cultures.
Currently, the global standard of measurement is the International System of Units (SI), which is a
modern form of the metric system. Although SI is intended for global use, it has not been fully
adopted, and some other systems of measurement are still used in parts of the world.

The intent of this site is to provide a convenient means to convert between the various units of
measurement within different systems, as well as to provide a basic understanding of the systems
currently in use, and how they interact. Refer to the [Common Unit Systems][120] page for further
information.
